If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
//_comment_speed: HARDENED TIMING: Hardcode period to 11.64ns to natively support 24x master crystal multiplier (85.91 MHz)
//: SYNTH_STRATEGY - Restores the stable balanced logic restructuring formula to keep sequential steering paths clean and routable at high speeds.
SYNTH_SIZING - Enables aggressive pre-placement cell sizing to scale up internal logic gates to high-performance variations early.
SYNTH_HIER_PASS - Directs Yosys to perform synthesis hierarchically, locking down local submodule ports before physical cell mapping.
SYNTH_FLATTEN - Disable global flattening to preserve submodule boundaries for physical macro bounding and hierarchical power grid connection

SYNTH_SHARE_RESOURCES - Dictates whether Yosys forces resource sharing by actively identifying matching algebraic sub-expressions (like duplicated multiplexers or address decoders) and merging them into unified gate networks. For purely combinational macros, leaving this enabled or disabled changes area footprint without breaking function.
SYNTH_NO_FLIP_FLOPS - Explicitly tells Yosys that the design does not contain structural sequential memory elements. This halts structural latched-path mapping loops.
ASYNCHRONOUS LOOP & GATES PROTECTION (RESTORED UPPERCASE)
SYNTH_DONT_CHOP_FLOATING - Disables OpenLane from deleting floating wires. Keeps dummy_cap lines alive.
SYNTH_GATES_REMAP - Stops Yosys from altering explicit cell layouts. Protects safe_async_mux cover terms.
SYNTH_BUFFERING - Forces Yosys to maintain sub-module hierarchies and prevents flattening.

SYNTH_TIMING_DERATING - Controls whether synchronous design flows calculation margin offsets for clock boundaries. Setting this to 0 prevents clock-skew analysis tools from complaining about your clockless layout.
SYNTH_ABC_LEGACY_FLOW - Forces OpenLane to drop the modern abc9 flow (which assumes structural sequential cell paths) and drop back to the standard legacy ABC string matching architecture.
SYNTH_EXPLORE_MODE - Instructs Yosys to process custom structural combinational feedbacks natively without generating lint exceptions.
SYNTH_READ_BLACKBOX_ATTRIBUTES - Forces the gate-level linter tool to drop loop alerts when analyzing cross-coupled asynchronous primitives.
SYNTH_MAX_FANOUT - Sets a matching high fanout ceiling for the front-end ABC logic mapping tool pass.

SYNTH_PARAMETERS - Passes top-level elaboration flags to Yosys to explicitly preserve the hierarchical structural boundaries of internal submodules like clock_synchronizer during physical gate mapping.

RUN_SYNTH_CHECKS - Controls the strict automated post-synthesis verification script checker. Disabling this to 0 prevents the Tiny Tapeout build harness from misinterpreting ABC combinational logic messages as fatal errors.
QUIT_ON_SYNTH_CHECKS - Forces Yosys to bypass design failures on multi-driver nets or combinational latching loops, permitting custom asynchronous paths.
MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT - Clamps internal signal fanout, forcing the tool to clone sluggish data lines and restore crisp transitions.
PL_REGIONS - Binds the entire unflattened u_c061618g2 macro logic block inside a strict physical coordinate bounding box on the Tiny Tapeout wrapper grid without needing a hard GDS database.
FP_CORE_UTIL - Force LibreLane to generate a much larger dynamic box for our 3% cell logic by lowering core utilization
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
//1: Master boolean activation switch that turns on the placement-stage timing repair tool block, instructing OpenROAD to actively resize logic gates and patch setup violations before routing begins.
//2: Forces the placement-stage timing repair tool to treat your target clock window as 60 picoseconds tighter, driving it to upgrade your output path buffers to clear the remaining 25ps deficit legally under the Tiny Tapeout hardware specifications.
//: PHYSICAL ROUTER & REPAIR BYPASSES (CRITICAL FOR CAPACITIVE LOADS)
PL_REPAIR_BUFFER_OUTPUTS - Blocks OpenROAD from injecting repeaters to fix your slow 100ps capacitive filter ramps.
GLB_REPAIR_REPEATER_INPUTS - Disables global routing buffer injection on input lines.
//1: Enables the late-stage global routing optimization loop, allowing OpenLane to drop heavy repeater buffers outside your frozen hierarchy boxes to patch the remaining 25ps deficit.
//2: Over-constrains the global router by 50 picoseconds to force the engine to select high-current driving cells for your external uo_out pin connections.
//: RUN_POST_GPL_DESIGN_REPAIR - Bypass LibreLane crash by forcing automatic hold-buffer insertion after global placement
RUN_POST_GRT_RESIZER_TIMING - Force a final round of precise hold-buffer patching after physical wire routing lines are drawn
RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR - Force physical cell legalisation and track repair after global routing to resolve severe hold violations
CELL_PAD - Increase cell padding to force the tool to leave empty space around every single logic gate
RUN_POST_GRT - Direct the global router to optimize timing routes with maximum iterations
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
GLB_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Enforces a deep global routing timing pass to restructure logic networks across module ports right before detailed routing.
PL_RESIZER_DESIGN_OPTIMIZATIONS - Grants the local resizer permission to insert high-drive tap buffers along setup-violating filter chains.
PL_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Runs critical slack path resizing directly within the global placement iteration window.
PL_RESIZER_HOLD_MAX_BUFFER_PERCENT - Keeps your existing 100% freedom allocation active for fixing hold timing violations.
PL_RESIZE_BUFFER_PERCENTAGE - Allocates 40% extra optimization budget to allow OpenROAD to upsize slow gates to high-drive variants along your 229 MHz critical paths.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
